name: bars-basic
notes: The child's validation suite over the `bars` stream (ADR-0015): structure-level rules producing failing COUNTS; error rules can block a publish, warn NEVER blocks. Runs against any acquired snapshot: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --root ./ob --suite configs/suite-bars.json --snapshot <vid>.

rules.notes: An empty pull is a broken connector or dead keys, not a quiet day. For a full backfill raise min toward the expected bar count (~98k bars per symbol-year at 1-minute RTH).
Nulls in the field the LSTM trains on block the publish outright.
A non-positive close would blow up the log-return transform; the wide max only exists so the rule reads as a sanity band, not a forecast.
An unexpected symbol is worth a look, not a blocked publish — warn never blocks. Tightening to error is one word if the universe is contractual.
effective_date <= acquired_at, re-asserted as recorded evidence (acquire already refuses violations at save time).
